quests.prerequisites: Must be able to enter Gerudo Town
quests.objective: Get Pokki a Noble Pursuit by bringing ice from the Northern Icehouse to Furosa.
quests.reward: Access to the Misae Suma shrine

quests.name: The Seven Heroines
quests.giverLocation: Gerudo Town, her home next to The Noble Canteen
quests.prerequisites: Must be able to enter Gerudo Town
quests.objective: Place seven orbs before the matching statues of the Seven Heroines at the East Gerudo Ruins.
quests.reward: Access to the Korsh O'hu shrine

quests.name: The Silent Swordswomen
quests.giverLocation: Gerudo Town, at the northwest gate
quests.objective: Follow the swordswoman statues through the West Barrens sandstorm.
quests.reward: Access to the Kema Zoos shrine

quests.name: The Undefeated Champ
quests.giverLocation: Sand-Seal Rally (with Shabonne)
quests.prerequisites: After freeing Vah Naboris
quests.objective: Beat Tali's sand-seal race record of 1:30 to win the Grand Trophy.
quests.reward: Access to the Raqa Zunzo shrine

quests.name: Cliffside Etchings
quests.giverLocation: Tabantha Bridge Stable, on the cliff behind it
quests.objective: Investigate the man-made-looking cliff face Geggle spots in the Gerudo Highlands.
quests.reward: Access to the Keeha Yoog shrine

quests.name: Sign of the Shadow
quests.giverLocation: Top of Gerudo Tower
quests.objective: Solve Kass's song about an arrow flying from the tower's shadow.

quests.limited: Sun or moon must be behind the tower (about 3-5 PM or 12-2 AM)
